BatchSetDesktopManager.description_en: Add or remove local administrator permissions on a cloud computer for a convenience account
BatchSetDesktopManager.description_zh: 为便捷账号添加或者去除云电脑的本地管理员权限

ChangeUserPassword.description_en: When the administrator activates the mode, you can use this API to modify the user logon password.
ChangeUserPassword.description_zh: 当用户为管理员激活模式时，可以通过该接口修改用户登录密码

CheckUsedProperty.description_en: Query the number of convenience accounts associated with a specified custom property
CheckUsedProperty.description_zh: 查询关联了指定自定义属性的便捷账号的数量

CheckUsedPropertyValue.description_en: Query the number of convenience accounts associated with a specified custom attribute value
CheckUsedPropertyValue.description_zh: 查询关联了指定自定义属性值的便捷账号的数量

CreateUsers.description_en: Easily create accounts for your end users
CreateUsers.description_zh: 为终端用户创建便捷账号

DeleteUserPropertyValue.description_en: Detach a user from a user attribute
DeleteUserPropertyValue.description_zh: 解除一个用户与某个用户属性的绑定关系

DescribeMfaDevices.description_en: Lists virtual MFA devices bound to directory accounts
DescribeMfaDevices.description_zh: 查询便捷账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

DescribeUsers.description_en: Queries convenience account information, such as usernames, email addresses, and remarks
DescribeUsers.description_zh: 查询便捷账号信息，例如用户名、邮箱地址、备注名称等

FilterUsers.description_en: Filter account information by user attribute
FilterUsers.description_zh: 按用户属性筛选查询便捷账号信息

GetManagerInfoByAuthCode.description_en: Obtains the information about the current logon administrator based on the authorization code
GetManagerInfoByAuthCode.description_zh: 根据authcode获取当前登录的管理员信息

GetUsersCount.description_zh: 获取无影便捷用户总数

ListProperty.description_en: Query the list of existing user attributes under the current account
ListProperty.description_zh: 查询当前账号下已有的用户属性列表

ListPropertyValue.description_en: Query the list of attribute values for a specific user attribute.
ListPropertyValue.description_zh: 查询某一用户属性包含的属性值列表

LockMfaDevice.description_en: Lock the virtual MFA device attached to a convenience account.
LockMfaDevice.description_zh: 锁定便捷账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

LockUsers.description_en: Locks one or more convenience accounts. Locked convenience accounts cannot be used to sign in to Wuying clients
LockUsers.description_zh: 锁定一个或者多个便捷账号。锁定后的便捷账号无法登录无影终端

ModifyGroup.description_en: Modify the name and description of a group
ModifyGroup.description_zh: 修改用户组的名称和描述

ModifyUser.description_en: Modify the contact information of a convenience account.
ModifyUser.description_zh: 修改便捷账号的联系方式

MoveUserOrg.description_en: Shift users to the target organization architecture
MoveUserOrg.description_zh: 移动用户到目标组织架构

RemoveGroup.description_en: Delete a group. Supports batch operations.
RemoveGroup.description_zh: 删除用户组。支持批量操作

RemoveMfaDevice.description_en: Delete the virtual MFA device attached to a convenience account.
RemoveMfaDevice.description_zh: 删除便捷账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

RemoveProperty.description_en: Delete a set of user attributes

RemoveUsers.description_en: Delete one or more convenience accounts
RemoveUsers.description_zh: 删除一个或者多个便捷账号

ResetUserPassword.description_en: Reset the password of a convenience account, including generating a password reset token and sending a password reset email to the mailbox of the convenience account
ResetUserPassword.description_zh: 重置便捷账号的密码，包括生成重置密码Token，并发送重置密码邮件到便捷账号的邮箱

SetUserPropertyValue.description_en: Associate a user attribute with a specific user
SetUserPropertyValue.description_zh: 为某个用户关联一个用户属性

TransferResourcesIntoGroup.description_en: 将资源转移到资源组中
TransferResourcesIntoGroup.description_zh: 将资源转移到资源组中

TransferResourcesOutofGroup.description_en: 将资源从资源组中转出
TransferResourcesOutofGroup.description_zh: 将资源从资源组中转出

UnlockMfaDevice.description_en: Unlock the virtual MFA device attached to a convenience account.
UnlockMfaDevice.description_zh: 解锁便捷账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

UnlockUsers.description_en: Unlock one or more convenience accounts. After being unlocked, the convenience accounts can log on to WUYING Terminal.
UnlockUsers.description_zh: 解锁一个或者多个便捷账号。解锁后的便捷账号可以登录无影终端

UserBatchJoinGroup.description_en: Add users to a group in batch
UserBatchJoinGroup.description_zh: 为用户组批量添加用户

UserBatchQuitGroup.description_en: Remove users from a group in batch
UserBatchQuitGroup.description_zh: 批量移除用户组中的用户
